text: In a rented house, the schoolteacher Asha nurses her ailing mother [until the old woman dies|trigger|losing family], while her son Vinu, jobless for two years, drifts back into smoking and drinking. Vinu begins to sense [someone else in the house|threat|the restless dead], but [friends and family decide something is wrong with him|rules|no one believes you], and Asha takes him to a counsellor. The counsellor learns from a neighbour that [a former tenant killed his wife and daughter there and hanged himself|origin|places with dark pasts], and that troubled tenants always behaved strangely in that house.
